known_issues: Dashboard shows admin wallet balance but also displays an error message like "admin wallet not recognize" (wallet recognition/validation mismatch).

existing_features.title: Fix the Dashboard UI so it never shows an admin wallet balance while simultaneously showing an admin-recognition error (e.g., “Not recognized as admin”). The admin wallet status (loading / not logged in / not an admin / error / success) must be derived consistently from the same data source and rendered in only one coherent state at a time.

Update admin gating logic on the Dashboard so admin-only actions (e.g., “Distribute Funds to User”) are shown based on a single canonical admin signal that cannot disagree with the displayed admin wallet balance (e.g., treat a successful admin wallet balance fetch as sufficient proof of admin access, and treat a null/unauthorized response as non-admin).

Harden the admin wallet balance query error handling so unauthorized/non-admin is not falsely inferred from non-auth errors. Ensure only true authorization failures result in a null admin wallet balance; other failures must surface as an error state to the UI.

projectName: Fix inconsistent admin wallet recognition message in Dashboard
